messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: eval-sentinel detected an output-drift + safety-regression on route /generate (model: redwood-edge-3q) — eval gate failed 4/5 tests, severity: P1. PagerDuty page sent to oncall.

pagerduty: PagerDuty alert created (INC-998233). Trigger: eval-gate-trip: safety_threshold_exceeded. Escalation policy: inference-oncall-primary.

samir: ack'd. Looking. @jessica tagging in case traffic impacts BAU.

samir: quick check — traffic to redwood-edge-3q is ~12% of production (canary tier). Initial eval logs show hallucination increase on the safety prompts set. Not seeing 5xxs or increased latency.

jessica: thx. any customer-facing reports?

samir: none yet from support. Quality regressions show higher toxicity on a small prompt slice. Example patterns saved to internal eval dashboard (link redacted).

samir: running quick mitigation: rolling traffic off redwood-edge-3q to fallback redwood-edge-3q-stable (manual routing). Running command now:

samir: ```
# route switch (internal tool)
infra-router route update --route /generate --from redwood-edge-3q --to redwood-edge-3q-stable --percent 0  --reason "eval gate fail"
```

incident-bot: Route update job queued. Change id: rt-2026-04-03-453.

pagerduty: Incident INC-998233 acknowledged by samir. Next escalation timer paused.

alex: copying notes — will inform support runbook to monitor tickets for regressions.

samir: rolling back a config change that landed yesterday (quantization-profile: q3-aggressive) against this model variant as additional safety. Command: ```infra-model revert-config redwood-edge-3q --config quantization-profile``` will revert to q2-safe.

incident-bot: Revert job started, ETA ~90s.

kate: grabbing logs for the failing eval set. If revert + routing stops failing tests we can consider this mitigated. Also prepping a hotfix canary (redwood-edge-3q-hotfix) with eval-guard enabled.

samir: revert completed; route now at 0% to problematic variant. Eval-sentinel re-run queued.

incident-bot: eval-sentinel re-evaluation results: 1/5 tests still failing (safety test borderline). Severity downgraded to P2.

jessica: good progress. Samir — excellent rapid rollback. Can you quantify customer impact? I want wording for status update.

samir: customer impact: none observed in support channels, latency normal, small subset of prompts in canary experienced higher safety flags but traffic was limited to 12%. Current risk: regression could've leaked to more traffic if rollout continued. Suggested status: "A canary model failed internal eval gates; we rolled traffic back and reverted a config change. No customer-facing errors observed; monitoring continues."

pagerduty: PagerDuty note: Escalation paused. Incident INC-998233 status: mitigation in progress.

kate: creating issue in infra/model-regressions with tags [eval, safety, quantization]. Assigning to model-onboard team for root cause and to infra-runtime for config safeguards.

alex: notifying support with suggested msg: "We've detected an internal quality regression in a canary model. Traffic was rolled back and we are monitoring. No customer action required."

ops-rotation: handoff: I'm going to take this for the next 2h to run through postmortem checklist and ensure eval gate tuning. @samir please hand me any artifacts.

samir: handing off. Attachments: eval-sentinel logs (link), route-change id rt-2026-04-03-453, revert job id rv-98765.

kate: long-term mitigation suggestions I've added to the issue: stronger pre-rollout eval gating (block on >2/5 safety fails), automated rollback-on-eval-fail for canaries, and a canary test harness that replays production prompt distribution against new variants.

jessica: also propose a brief tweak to the deploy checklist: require a safety sign-off when changing quantization-profile on models serving >5% traffic.

samir: agreed. For now I'll leave the incident open but moving to monitoring mode. Will close after 24h of clean eval results.

pagerduty: Incident INC-998233: status changed to monitoring. Next oncall: jessica at 2151238200.

incident-bot: Note added to thread: mitigation actions completed (route rollback, config revert, eval re-run). Tracking issue: INF-3342.

ops-rotation: I'm on it for the next shift. If any infra alarms or support tickets surface, page escalation policy will trigger.

jessica: thanks team. Great runbook execution. Will review the post-incident eval logs and propose gating parameter updates. :thumbsup:

samir: closing notes to add to the incident doc: timeline, commands used, small diff of eval results before/after, and next steps (INF-3342, assign owners).

incident-bot: Incident INC-998233 closed by jessica at 2151235030 (status: monitoring -> closed).
